17:6.kjv: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

17:7.web: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
17:7.kjv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

17:8.web: Upright men shall be astonished at this. The innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.
17:8.kjv: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

bsb: and the one with clean hands
17:9.web: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way. He who has clean hands shall grow stronger and stronger.
17:9.kjv: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

17:10.web: But as for you all, come on now again; I shall not find a wise man among you.
17:10.kjv: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

17:11.web: My days are past, my plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
17:11.kjv: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

17:12.web: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
17:12.kjv: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

17:13.web: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
17:13.kjv: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

17:14.web: If I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘my sister;’
17:14.kjv: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

17:15.web: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
17:15.kjv: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

17:16.web: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
17:16.kjv: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

18:1.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

18:2.web: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
18:2.kjv: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

18:3.web: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
18:3.kjv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

18:4.web: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?
18:4.kjv: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

18:5.web: “Yes, the light of the wicked shall be put out, The spark of his fire shall not shine.
18:5.kjv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

18:6.web: The light shall be dark in his tent. His lamp above him shall be put out.
18:6.kjv: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

18:7.web: The steps of his strength shall be shortened. His own counsel shall cast him down.
18:7.kjv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

18:8.web: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
18:8.kjv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

18:9.web: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
18:9.kjv: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

18:10.web: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
18:10.kjv: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

18:11.web: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall chase him at his heels.
18:11.kjv: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

18:12.web: His strength shall be famished. Calamity shall be ready at his side.
18:12.kjv: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

18:13.web: The members of his body shall be devoured. The firstborn of death shall devour his members.
18:13.kjv: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

18:14.web: He shall be rooted out of the security of his tent. He shall be brought to the king of terrors.
18:14.kjv: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

18:15.web: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur shall be scattered on his habitation.
18:15.kjv: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

18:16.web: His roots shall be dried up beneath. Above shall his branch be cut off.
18:16.kjv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

18:17.web: His memory shall perish from the earth. He shall have no name in the street.
18:17.kjv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

18:18.web: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
18:18.kjv: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

18:19.web: He shall have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
18:19.kjv: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

18:20.web: Those who come after shall be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
18:20.kjv: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

18:21.web: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
18:21.kjv: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

19:2.web: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
19:2.kjv: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

19:3.web: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
19:3.kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

19:4.web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
19:4.kjv: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

19:5.web: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;
19:5.kjv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

19:6.web: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
19:6.kjv: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

19:7.web: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
19:7.kjv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

19:8.web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
19:8.kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

19:9.web: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
19:9.kjv: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

19:10.web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. My hope he has plucked up like a tree.
19:10.kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

19:11.web: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
19:11.kjv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

19:12.web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
19:12.kjv: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

19:13.web: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
19:13.kjv: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

19:14.web: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
19:14.kjv: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

19:15.web: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
19:15.kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

19:16.web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
19:16.kjv: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

19:17.web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
19:17.kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.

19:18.web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
19:18.kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

19:19.web: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
19:19.kjv: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

19:20.web: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
19:20.kjv: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

19:21.web: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
19:21.kjv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

19:22.web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
19:22.kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

19:23.web: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
19:23.kjv: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

19:24.web: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
19:24.kjv: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

19:25.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
19:25.kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

19:26.web: After my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh shall I see God,
19:26.kjv: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

19:27.web: Whom I, even I, shall see on my side. My eyes shall see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
19:27.kjv: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

19:28.web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
19:28.kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

19:29.web: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
19:29.kjv: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

20:1.kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

20:2.web: “Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
20:2.kjv: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

20:3.web: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
20:3.kjv: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

20:4.web: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
20:4.kjv: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

20:5.web: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
20:5.kjv: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

20:6.web: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
20:6.kjv: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

20:7.web: yet he shall perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him shall say, ‘Where is he?’
20:7.kjv: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

20:8.web: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found. Yes, he shall be chased away like a vision of the night.
20:8.kjv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

20:9.web: The eye which saw him shall see him no more, neither shall his place any more see him.
20:9.kjv: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

20:10.web: His children shall seek the favor of the poor. His hands shall give back his wealth.
20:10.kjv: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

20:11.web: His bones are full of his youth, but youth shall lie down with him in the dust.
20:11.kjv: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

20:12.web: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
20:12.kjv: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

20:13.web: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;
20:13.kjv: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

20:14.web: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
20:14.kjv: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

20:15.web: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
20:15.kjv: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

20:16.web: He shall suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue shall kill him.
20:16.kjv: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

20:17.web: He shall not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
20:17.kjv: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

20:18.web: That for which he labored he shall restore, and shall not swallow it down. According to the substance that he has gotten, he shall not rejoice.
20:18.kjv: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

20:19.web: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.
20:19.kjv: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

20:20.web: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he shall not save anything of that in which he delights.
20:20.kjv: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

20:21.web: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity shall not endure.
20:21.kjv: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

20:22.web: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress shall overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery shall come on him.
20:22.kjv: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

20:23.web: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
20:23.kjv: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

20:24.web: He shall flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow shall strike him through.
20:24.kjv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

20:25.web: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
20:25.kjv: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

20:26.web: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire shall devour him. It shall consume that which is left in his tent.
20:26.kjv: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

20:27.web: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity. The earth shall rise up against him.
20:27.kjv: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

20:28.web: The increase of his house shall depart. They shall rush away in the day of his wrath.
20:28.kjv: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

20:29.web: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
20:29.kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

21:2.web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
21:2.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

21:3.web: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
21:3.kjv: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

21:4.web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
21:4.kjv: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

21:5.web: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
21:5.kjv: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

21:6.web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
21:6.kjv: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

21:7.web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
21:7.kjv: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

21:8.web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
21:8.kjv: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

21:9.web: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
21:9.kjv: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

21:10.web: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
21:10.kjv: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

21:11.web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
21:11.kjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

21:12.web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
21:12.kjv: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

21:13.web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
21:13.kjv: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

21:14.web: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
21:14.kjv: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

21:15.web: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
21:15.kjv: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

21:16.web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
21:16.kjv: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

21:17.web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
21:17.kjv: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

21:18.web: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
21:18.kjv: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

21:19.web: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
21:19.kjv: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.

21:20.web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
21:20.kjv: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

21:21.web: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
21:21.kjv: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

21:22.web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
21:22.kjv: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

21:23.web: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
21:23.kjv: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

21:24.web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
21:24.kjv: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

21:25.web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
21:25.kjv: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

21:26.web: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
21:26.kjv: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

21:27.web: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
21:27.kjv: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

21:28.web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
21:28.kjv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

21:29.web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
21:29.kjv: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

21:30.web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
21:30.kjv: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

21:31.web: Who shall declare his way to his face? Who shall repay him what he has done?
21:31.kjv: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

21:32.web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men shall keep watch over the tomb.
21:32.kjv: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

21:33.web: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him. All men shall draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
21:33.kjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

21:34.web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
21:34.kjv: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?

22:1.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

22:2.web: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
22:2.kjv: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

22:3.web: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?
22:3.kjv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him that thou makest thy ways perfect?

22:4.web: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
22:4.kjv: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

22:5.web: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
22:5.kjv: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

22:6.web: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
22:6.kjv: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

22:7.web: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
22:7.kjv: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

22:8.web: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
22:8.kjv: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

22:9.web: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
22:9.kjv: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

22:10.web: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
22:10.kjv: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

22:11.web: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
22:11.kjv: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

22:12.web: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
22:12.kjv: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

22:13.web: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
22:13.kjv: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

22:14.web: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
22:14.kjv: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

22:15.web: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
22:15.kjv: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

22:16.web: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
22:16.kjv: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

22:17.web: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
22:17.kjv: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

22:18.web: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
22:18.kjv: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

22:19.web: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
22:19.kjv: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

22:20.web: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
22:20.kjv: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

22:21.web: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.
22:21.kjv: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

22:22.web: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
22:22.kjv: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

22:23.web: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
22:23.kjv: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

22:24.web: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
22:24.kjv: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

22:25.web: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
22:25.kjv: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

22:26.web: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.
22:26.kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

22:27.web: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.
22:27.kjv: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

22:28.web: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.
22:28.kjv: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

22:29.web: When they cast down, you shall say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
22:29.kjv: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

22:30.web: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
22:30.kjv: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

23:2.web: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
23:2.kjv: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

23:3.web: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
23:3.kjv: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

23:4.web: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
23:4.kjv: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

23:5.web: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
23:5.kjv: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

23:6.web: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
23:6.kjv: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

23:7.web: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
23:7.kjv: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

23:8.web: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
23:8.kjv: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

23:9.web: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
23:9.kjv: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

23:10.web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come out like gold.
23:10.kjv: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

23:11.web: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
23:11.kjv: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

23:12.web: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
23:12.kjv: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

23:13.web: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
23:13.kjv: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

23:14.web: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
23:14.kjv: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

23:15.web: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
23:15.kjv: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

23:16.web: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
23:16.kjv: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

23:17.web: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
23:17.kjv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

bsb: Why may those who know Him
24:1.web: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
24:1.kjv: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

24:2.web: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
24:2.kjv: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

24:3.web: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
24:3.kjv: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

24:4.web: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
24:4.kjv: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

24:5.web: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
24:5.kjv: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

24:6.web: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
24:6.kjv: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

24:7.web: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
24:7.kjv: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

24:8.web: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
24:8.kjv: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

24:9.web: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
24:9.kjv: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

24:10.web: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
24:10.kjv: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

24:11.web: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
24:11.kjv: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

24:12.web: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
24:12.kjv: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.

24:13.web: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
24:13.kjv: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

24:14.web: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
24:14.kjv: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

24:15.web: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye shall see me.’ He disguises his face.
24:15.kjv: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

24:16.web: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
24:16.kjv: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

24:17.web: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
24:17.kjv: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

24:18.web: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
24:18.kjv: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

24:19.web: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
24:19.kjv: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

24:20.web: The womb shall forget him. The worm shall feed sweetly on him. He shall be no more remembered. Unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.
24:20.kjv: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

24:21.web: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
24:21.kjv: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

24:22.web: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
24:22.kjv: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

24:23.web: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
24:23.kjv: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

24:24.web: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
24:24.kjv: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

24:25.web: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
24:25.kjv: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

25:1.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

25:2.web: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
25:2.kjv: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

25:3.web: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
25:3.kjv: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

25:4.web: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
25:4.kjv: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

25:5.web: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
25:5.kjv: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

25:6.web: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
25:6.kjv: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

26:2.web: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
26:2.kjv: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

26:3.web: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
26:3.kjv: How hast thou counseled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

26:4.web: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
26:4.kjv: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

bsb: and those who dwell in them.
26:5.web: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
26:5.kjv: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

26:6.web: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
26:6.kjv: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

26:7.web: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
26:7.kjv: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

26:8.web: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
26:8.kjv: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

26:9.web: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
26:9.kjv: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

26:10.web: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
26:10.kjv: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

26:11.web: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
26:11.kjv: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

26:12.web: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
26:12.kjv: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

26:13.web: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
26:13.kjv: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

26:14.web: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
26:14.kjv: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

27:1.web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
27:1.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

27:2.web: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
27:2.kjv: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

27:3.web: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
27:3.kjv: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

27:4.web: surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit.
27:4.kjv: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

27:5.web: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
27:5.kjv: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

27:6.web: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
27:6.kjv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

27:7.web: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
27:7.kjv: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

27:8.web: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
27:8.kjv: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

27:9.web: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
27:9.kjv: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

27:10.web: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
27:10.kjv: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

27:11.web: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
27:11.kjv: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

27:12.web: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
27:12.kjv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

27:13.web: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
27:13.kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

27:14.web: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
27:14.kjv: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

27:15.web: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death. His widows shall make no lamentation.
27:15.kjv: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

27:16.web: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
27:16.kjv: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

27:17.web: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
27:17.kjv: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

27:18.web: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
27:18.kjv: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

bsb: but will do so no more;
27:19.web: He lies down rich, but he shall not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
27:19.kjv: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

27:20.web: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
27:20.kjv: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

27:21.web: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
27:21.kjv: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

27:22.web: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
27:22.kjv: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

27:23.web: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
27:23.kjv: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

28:1.web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
28:1.kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

28:2.web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
28:2.kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

28:3.web: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
28:3.kjv: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

28:4.web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
28:4.kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

28:5.web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
28:5.kjv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

28:6.web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
28:6.kjv: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

28:7.web: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
28:7.kjv: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:

28:8.web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
28:8.kjv: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

28:9.web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
28:9.kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

28:10.web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
28:10.kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

28:11.web: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
28:11.kjv: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

28:12.web: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
28:12.kjv: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

28:13.web: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
28:13.kjv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

28:14.web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
28:14.kjv: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

28:15.web: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.
28:15.kjv: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

28:16.web: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
28:16.kjv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

28:17.web: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
28:17.kjv: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

28:18.web: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
28:18.kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

28:19.web: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
28:19.kjv: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

28:20.web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
28:20.kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

28:21.web: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
28:21.kjv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

28:22.web: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
28:22.kjv: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

28:23.web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
28:23.kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

28:24.web: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
28:24.kjv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

28:25.web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
28:25.kjv: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

28:26.web: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;
28:26.kjv: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

28:27.web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
28:27.kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

28:28.web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
28:28.kjv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

29:1.web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
29:1.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

29:2.web: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
29:2.kjv: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

29:3.web: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
29:3.kjv: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

29:4.web: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
29:4.kjv: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

29:5.web: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
29:5.kjv: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

29:6.web: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
29:6.kjv: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

29:7.web: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
29:7.kjv: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

29:8.web: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
29:8.kjv: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

29:9.web: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
29:9.kjv: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

bsb: to the roofs of their mouths.
29:10.web: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
29:10.kjv: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

29:11.web: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:
29:11.kjv: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

29:12.web: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
29:12.kjv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

29:13.web: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
29:13.kjv: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

29:14.web: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
29:14.kjv: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

29:15.web: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
29:15.kjv: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

29:16.web: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn’t know, I searched out.
29:16.kjv: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

29:17.web: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
29:17.kjv: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

29:18.web: Then I said, ‘I shall die in my own house, I shall count my days as the sand.
29:18.kjv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

29:19.web: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
29:19.kjv: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

29:20.web: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
29:20.kjv: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

29:21.web: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
29:21.kjv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

29:22.web: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
29:22.kjv: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

29:23.web: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
29:23.kjv: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

29:24.web: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
29:24.kjv: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

29:25.web: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
29:25.kjv: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

30:1.web: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.
30:1.kjv: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

30:2.web: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
30:2.kjv: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

30:3.web: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
30:3.kjv: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

30:4.web: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom are their food.
30:4.kjv: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

30:5.web: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief;
30:5.kjv: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

30:6.web: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
30:6.kjv: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

30:7.web: Among the bushes they bray; and under the nettles they are gathered together.
30:7.kjv: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

30:8.web: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
30:8.kjv: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

30:9.web: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
30:9.kjv: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

30:10.web: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
30:10.kjv: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

30:11.web: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
30:11.kjv: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

30:12.web: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.
30:12.kjv: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

30:13.web: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, without anyone’s help.
30:13.kjv: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

30:14.web: As through a wide breach they come, in the middle of the ruin they roll themselves in.
30:14.kjv: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

30:15.web: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
30:15.kjv: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

30:16.web: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold on me.
30:16.kjv: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

30:17.web: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
30:17.kjv: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

30:18.web: By great force is my garment disfigured. It binds me about as the collar of my coat.
30:18.kjv: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

30:19.web: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
30:19.kjv: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

30:20.web: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
30:20.kjv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.

30:21.web: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
30:21.kjv: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

30:22.web: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
30:22.kjv: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

30:23.web: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
30:23.kjv: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

30:24.web: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
30:24.kjv: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

30:25.web: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
30:25.kjv: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

30:26.web: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.
30:26.kjv: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

30:27.web: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
30:27.kjv: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

30:28.web: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
30:28.kjv: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

30:29.web: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
30:29.kjv: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

30:30.web: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
30:30.kjv: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

30:31.web: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
30:31.kjv: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

31:1.web: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
31:1.kjv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

31:2.web: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
31:2.kjv: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

31:3.web: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
31:3.kjv: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

31:4.web: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
31:4.kjv: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

31:5.web: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
31:5.kjv: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

31:6.web: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
31:6.kjv: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.

31:7.web: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
31:7.kjv: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

31:8.web: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
31:8.kjv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

31:9.web: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
31:9.kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;

bsb: for another, and may other men
31:10.web: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
31:10.kjv: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

31:11.web: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges:
31:11.kjv: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

31:12.web: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
31:12.kjv: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

31:13.web: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me;
31:13.kjv: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

31:14.web: What then shall I do when God rises up? When he visits, what shall I answer him?
31:14.kjv: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

31:15.web: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
31:15.kjv: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

31:16.web: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
31:16.kjv: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

31:17.web: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
31:17.kjv: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

31:18.web: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, her I have guided from my mother’s womb);
31:18.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)

31:19.web: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
31:19.kjv: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

31:20.web: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
31:20.kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

31:21.web: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
31:21.kjv: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

31:22.web: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
31:22.kjv: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

31:23.web: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because his majesty, I can do nothing.
31:23.kjv: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

31:24.web: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
31:24.kjv: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

31:25.web: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
31:25.kjv: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;

31:26.web: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
31:26.kjv: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

31:27.web: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
31:27.kjv: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

31:28.web: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.
31:28.kjv: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.

31:29.web: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
31:29.kjv: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

31:30.web: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
31:30.kjv: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

31:31.web: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
31:31.kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

31:32.web: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
31:32.kjv: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

31:33.web: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
31:33.kjv: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

31:34.web: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
31:34.kjv: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

31:35.web: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
31:35.kjv: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

31:36.web: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.
31:36.kjv: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

31:37.web: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.
31:37.kjv: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

31:38.web: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
31:38.kjv: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

31:39.web: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
31:39.kjv: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

31:40.web: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
31:40.kjv: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

32:1.web: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
32:1.kjv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

32:2.web: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
32:2.kjv: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

32:3.web: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
32:3.kjv: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

32:4.web: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
32:4.kjv: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

32:5.web: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
32:5.kjv: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

32:6.web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
32:6.kjv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

32:7.web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
32:7.kjv: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

32:8.web: But there is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.
32:8.kjv: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

32:9.web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
32:9.kjv: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

32:10.web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
32:10.kjv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

32:11.web: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
32:11.kjv: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

32:12.web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
32:12.kjv: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

32:13.web: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom, God may refute him, not man;’
32:13.kjv: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

32:14.web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
32:14.kjv: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

32:15.web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
32:15.kjv: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

32:16.web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
32:16.kjv: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

32:17.web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
32:17.kjv: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

32:18.web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
32:18.kjv: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

32:19.web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
32:19.kjv: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

32:20.web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
32:20.kjv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

32:21.web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
32:21.kjv: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

32:22.web: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles; or else my Maker would soon take me away.
32:22.kjv: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

33:1.web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
33:1.kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

33:2.web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
33:2.kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

33:3.web: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
33:3.kjv: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

33:4.web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
33:4.kjv: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

33:5.web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
33:5.kjv: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

bsb: am just like you before God;
33:6.web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
33:6.kjv: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

33:7.web: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.
33:7.kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

33:8.web: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
33:8.kjv: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

33:9.web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
33:9.kjv: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

33:10.web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
33:10.kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

33:11.web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
33:11.kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

33:12.web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
33:12.kjv: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

33:13.web: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
33:13.kjv: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

33:14.web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
33:14.kjv: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

33:15.web: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
33:15.kjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

33:16.web: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
33:16.kjv: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

33:17.web: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
33:17.kjv: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

33:18.web: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
33:18.kjv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

33:19.web: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones;
33:19.kjv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

33:20.web: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
33:20.kjv: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

33:21.web: His flesh is so consumed away, that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
33:21.kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

33:22.web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
33:22.kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

33:23.web: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
33:23.kjv: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

33:24.web: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
33:24.kjv: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

33:25.web: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
33:25.kjv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:

33:26.web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
33:26.kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

33:27.web: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
33:27.kjv: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

33:28.web: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.’
33:28.kjv: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

33:29.web: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
33:29.kjv: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

33:30.web: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
33:30.kjv: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

33:31.web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
33:31.kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

33:32.web: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
33:32.kjv: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

33:33.web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
33:33.kjv: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

34:2.web: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
34:2.kjv: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

34:3.web: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
34:3.kjv: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

34:4.web: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
34:4.kjv: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

34:5.web: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
34:5.kjv: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

34:6.web: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
